Finite foundations. In a nonnegative finite-cone representation, a dependence b among active columns permits replacing coefficients a by a−tb, where the sign of b ensures some positive entry and t=min(a_j/b_j) over positive entries. Coefficients remain nonnegative and one vanishes. Iterate to independent columns. Their inverse maps bound coefficients by constants times the represented norm. A convergent sequence has a subsequence using one fixed independent subset and convergent bounded coefficients, proving cone closedness, including zero generators and signed lineality generators.

For an inequality cone, quotient its kernel. On a complement the sum of defining nonnegative forms is positive away from zero. Its level-one section is compact: normalization of an unbounded sequence would produce a unit cone vector where that sum vanishes. Move a nonvertex in both signed null directions of its active equations until an additional independent constraint becomes active. Boundedness supplies both endpoints; active-rank induction yields finitely many generating vertices, rational for rational data. Restore signed lineality directions. Homogenization yields finite generating POINTS and exact recession rays for every nonempty rational polyhedron; points need not be vertices with lineality. Conversely, eliminating coefficient variables by pairing lower and upper bounds gives an exact finite weak-inequality description. A compact point hull plus a closed finite cone is closed.

Nearest-point variation separates an outside y from a closed cone: for nearest z, (z−y)·u≥0 on the cone and (z−y)·y=−||z−y||²<0. The CLOSED hull of finitely many source polyhedra equals the hull of all point generators plus the cone of all source rays. The reverse inclusion uses actual small-mass combinations (1−δ)u+δ(a+r/δ)→u+r. Approximate u in the closed hull and iterate over rays. No unclosed union hull is assumed closed.

A finite full-space convex function is locally Lipschitz: cube vertex upper bounds, reflection lower bounds and extended secants give two-sided difference estimates on a smaller ball. Its epigraph is closed. Project points immediately below its graph, normalize nearest-projection normals and take a unit limit. The vertical coefficient is nonnegative by upward stability and strictly positive because a nonzero horizontal normal cannot bound the full spatial projection. Division gives an affine lower support everywhere. A full-domain polyhedral epigraph consequently gives a finite real affine maximum; recession h is the maximum of its linear parts, epi(h) is its exact recession cone, and f(x+v)≤f(x)+h(v).

For a full finite-fiber epigraph generated by rational spatial points/rays with arbitrary REAL heights, a lower support selects equality points and zero-slack rays, excluding the vertical ray. Its injective graph projection is a rational point hull plus rational cone. All nonempty subfaces remain lower by small perturbations of exposing functionals preserving finitely many slacks and the positive vertical coefficient; the empty face can be included vacuously. Unique lower heights identify intersections with projected common faces. These finite rational projections cover the domain. Matching affine coefficients on rational face bases satisfy a rational homogeneous system. A rational kernel basis, with denominators cleared on all saturated tangent lattices, gives literal integral-slope/rational-constant PA functions whose finite real span contains the actual matching data. Arbitrary irrational maximum walls are never declared rational.

Ambient local affine lower supports imply convexity on every contained segment. After subtracting its endpoint chord, a positive interior maximum forces zero supporting directional slope, making the maximum set both open and closed, contradicting endpoint values. At a legal PCC center, convex secants along each assigned incident cell give f(x_j)≥f(x)+p(x_j−x); real weighted summation proves Jensen. On a common PA carrier the divisor coefficient is Σcσ fσ(nσ/ρ)−fρ(Σcσ nσ/ρ). A support agrees with tangent derivatives. Subtract it; actual balancing cancels its contribution and every inward residual is nonnegative. Primitive representatives may have tangent components, which cancel. This uses actual saturated classes and assigns no MA.

E0–E4. Choose one rational origin and tangent coordinates on H=aff τ, with rational page complements and block l1 norms. At a relative-interior point of τ, the active equality set is exactly τ: short signed moves preserve inactive slack, and the face property forces equality-set points into τ. The sum of active slacks exposes τ. Therefore σ∩H=τ. Restricted inequalities at t have violation at most J||s||. For nearest z in the restricted face polyhedron, w=t−z belongs to its active outward-normal cone; otherwise cone separation gives a short feasible improving direction. Independent active representation gives Σλ≤C||w|| and ||w||²=Σλ(n·t−b)≤CΔ(t)||w||. Norm equivalence yields ||t−z||₁≤K||s||₁ globally, including boundary and unbounded slack. Point H and τ=H use K=0. No irrational projection is labeled rational.

Assume explicit GLOBAL cell Lipschitz L. Choose rational M,B>L and B≥L(K+1)+MK; N=M||t||₁+B||s||₁. F(x)=infσ[f(y)+N(x−y)] has lower bound f(y₀)−L||x−y₀|| and a finite upper evaluation. Convex epsilon-minimizers prove convexity; triangle inequalities give global Lipschitzness. On the entire σ every candidate is ≥f(x), with equality at y=x. Strict min(M,B)>L also makes minimizing sequences coercive and yields attainment. At x=(h,0), select z as above. The inequalities f(t,s)≥fτ(z)−L(K+1)||s|| and M||h−t||≥M||h−z||−MK||s|| show every candidate is ≥fτ(z)+M||h−z||. Conversely every z∈τ is allowed. Thus on WHOLE H, F=infτ[fτ(z)+M||h−z||], finite convex Lipschitz and exact on τ. A common H norm and M, with separate sufficiently large B_i, synchronize this entire trace.

If uniformly coordinate-bounded identical ambient p_y support all originals at actual y∈τ, enlarge norms to dominate them while retaining trace inequalities. Every candidate is ≥f_i(y)+p_y(x−y), so the SAME support persists on every entire extended page at actual τ only. Working299 supplies neither L nor these supports.

For actual REAL affine ℓ=a+b positive on EVERY nonzero original recession direction, retain both trace inequalities and dominate its slopes. Γ=infσ[ℓ+N] is exact on entire σ and has the analogous whole-H trace. If |f−ℓ|≤C, cost comparison gives |F−Γ|≤C globally. Finite original generators give ℓ(y)≥c||y||−D by choosing c below all positive ray-height/norm ratios; bounded cells allow any c with suitable D. Nonzero lineality is excluded by simultaneous positivity on r and −r. Hence Γ≥min(c,M,B)||x||−D and fibers attain. Its exact epigraph uses lifted original points, exact affine recession rays, norm rays and the vertical ray. The preceding primal graph argument proves genuine rational-spatial REAL-PA. Whole-cell equality preserves original recession slopes, and coercivity gives positive new recession.

E5. With v₁=(0,1,0), v₂=(0,0,1), v₃=(0,−1,−1), original σ_i={s≥0,0≤t+s≤1}, ℓ=f=s, K=1,M=2,B=4, the cost is r+2|t−u+r|+4|s−r|. Every candidate is ≥−2t+2u−r+4|s−r|≥−2t−s. Equality forces u=0,r=s≥0,t+s≤0, and those choices attain it. Thus R={s≥0,t+s≤0} is the actual projected lower face, with its negative H ray a face. The entire trace is 2dist(t,[0,1]). At rational center −e₀, assigned incident endpoints −e₀+v_i/4 have mean center, values 7/4 and center value2: the LEGAL PCC cost is −1/4. Original actual-face supports do not extend compatibly outside τ. The original partial support has single-sided outer facets and is unbalanced, so this is not a balanced-original counterexample.

Whole-affine majorants/E6. For the stated finite convex rational-spatial REAL-PA positive-growth Γ, its finite carrier makes its convex epigraph polyhedral by finite point/ray generation. Write Γ=max(a_j·x+b_j), h=max a_j·x and Δ=conv{a_j}. Bounded f−Γ implies bounded f−h. The conjugate f* is finite uniformly bounded exactly on Δ; compact-set separation gives infinity outside. It is convex lower semicontinuous and continuous on ALL Δ: at p, inactive inequality slacks provide a fixed feasible ray radius r toward nearby q; vertex values bound it above by B, giving f*(q)≤f*(p)+||q−p||(B−f*(p))/r, while lower semicontinuity gives the reverse limit. Irrational vertices remain actual real vertices.

Continuity of f permits rational primal samples in its transform supremum. Continuity of f* and compactness select finite rational A, including prescribed finite rational S, with f*−η≤max_A(p·x−f(x))≤f* uniformly on Δ. Recession cones of the whole finite rational Γ carrier cover all directions, and h is the cell slope on each. Their exact rational-spatial/REAL-height lifted rays generate epi(h). Every support slope of f lies in Δ by bounded difference. Using a support at x+v proves f(x+v)≤f(x)+h(v) BEFORE epigraph inclusion. Thus E=conv{(x,f(x)):x∈A}+epi(h)⊂epi(f). Its closed full-domain attained lower function P is genuine REAL-PA. Direct conjugation gives P*=max_A(p·x−f(x)) on Δ and infinity outside. Affine supports prove biconjugacy, hence f≤P≤f+η. Sample lifts give exact contacts. Dividing forward representations by their parameter proves rec(E)=epi(h), so recession is exact. With η_n=2⁻ⁿ, Q_n=P_n+4η_n has error in [4,5]η_n and Q_n−Q_{n+1}≥3η_n/2, decreasing uniformly. Shifted contacts are not exact. Independent majorants supply no synchronized face traces or supports. The direct-original balanced all-face approximation gap remains OPEN.

notes.text:
This reconstruction uses the finite-cone, closure, support, rational graph and scalar-matching proofs in n1. No supplied theorem is an unproved premise. Complete arguments are in reconstructed-proofs.md and proof-coverage.md.

Assume finitely many distinct equal-d complete rational affine pages with EVERY pair intersection exactly ONE rational H, common actual nonempty face τ with aff τ=H and σ_i∩H=τ, and actual REAL affine ℓ_i agreeing on H and positive on EVERY nonzero original recession direction. A common ambient support p₀ at one rational relative-interior τ point suffices. It follows from printed affine-star PC without balancing or independence: choose rational assigned tangent-cone generators w_j, including both signs of an H basis, with actual real costs c_j. Inactive slack permits common short rational endpoints y+δw_j. For every nonnegative REAL zero list λ with Σλw=0, normalize its nonzero total to a legal PCC; affinity gives Σλc≥0. Therefore cone{(w_j,c_j),(0,1)} excludes (0,−1). It is closed by n1. Separation q(w)+bt≥0 with negative value at (0,−1) forces b>0, and p₀=−q/b supports every generator. Signed H directions force equality with the trace derivative. Generation and affinity give support on ENTIRE original cells and at every actual τ point.

Choose exact rational original point/ray lists and a rational ambient norm m||·|| dominating p₀. Define E_G as the hull of (q_ia,ℓ_i(q_ia)) plus the cone of (r_ib,ℓ_i,lin(r_ib)), (±e_j,m) and (0,1). The proved small-mass closure identity makes this the exact closed original-union hull plus norm cone. Every generator lies above P(x)=ℓτ(y)+p₀(x−y). Norm rays give full projection and finite upper candidates; closed fibers attain their finite lower G. Choose c>0 below m and every positive original ray-height/norm ratio, and D for the finite point heights. Every representation has height≥c||x||−D by the triangle inequality. Spatial cancellation only decreases the represented norm, so there is no coercivity gap. Norm recession gives global Lipschitzness and n1 gives genuine REAL-PA. Original inclusion gives G≤ℓ_i on entire σ_i; the floor P forces exact τ values.

Let g=G|H. It is proper finite convex Lipschitz, equals ℓτ on actual τ and satisfies g≥ℓτ on ALL H. Intersect the rational carrier with H. Include points and recession rays of EVERY trace cell, lifted with actual g heights and h_G slopes; the latter equal cell slopes by the full-domain recession limit. Convexity and recession stability give one inclusion, and each cell's exact point/ray graph representation gives the other: epi(g)=conv{(h_a,g(h_a))}+cone{(w_b,h_G(w_b)),(0,1)}. This includes every unbounded trace cell and point H.

Choose rational page norms N_i dominating BOTH ℓ_i,lin and h_G on all page directions. Form E_i=closedconv(epi(ℓ_i+Iσ_i)∪epi(g))+epi(N_i), using all exact finite original/trace points and rays. For G, original points are above G, original rays belong to rec(E_G), trace points have equality and trace rays have h_G height; norm rays dominate h_G. For ℓ_i, original generators have equality, trace points satisfy g≥ℓτ, and division along trace rays gives their heights≥ℓ_i,lin; norm rays also dominate that derivative. Thus E_i⊂epi(G|V_i)∩epi(ℓ_i). Its full attained lower Γ_i is ≥BOTH. Original and trace epigraph inclusion gives the opposite inequalities on ENTIRE σ_i and WHOLE H, proving Γ_i=ℓ_i and Γ_i|H=g exactly. Finiteness comes from one point plus norm rays, properness from Γ_i≥G, Lipschitzness from norm recession and REAL-PA from primal lower faces. No unsupported max(G,ℓ_i) is substituted.

At EVERY h∈H an ambient support of G also supports ALL entire Γ_i, because they dominate G and equal it there. Off H a sufficiently small neighborhood meets only its unique page. Hence n1's local-support argument proves continuous printed PC, including real endpoint tests. Extend all rational page/trace wall covectors and page/H equations ambiently; one finite rational hyperplane arrangement refines all carriers and agrees on H. A common rational matching kernel proves finite REAL scalar-extension membership. The lower bound by G forces positive growth on every new nonzero recession ray.

With specified positive REAL constant page weights, opposite saturated primitive inward quotient classes cancel separately on the two sides of each page subdivision facet, including H facets when codimension one. Dependence causes no problem. Rational weights give the literal BMPS convention; real weights here mean the separately proved real balancing equations, with no MA extension. Nonzero original lineality is excluded by strict affine positivity in both signed directions; signed tangent H directions remain valid. Point H uses one trace point and a vertical ray. A zero-dimensional complete space is one point with vacuous recession/balancing. A lone page with τ=σ uses n1's auxiliary, which is globally ≥ℓ because its norm dominates the derivative. Distinct pages cannot intersect in their full dimension.

For the diagnostic, R=max(|a|,|b|,−t,t−1) is an explicit compatible reference: on originals max(|a|,|b|)=s, −t=s−u≤s and t−1=u−s−1≤s. It equals ℓ on entire originals, has trace dist(t,[0,1]) and is ≥(|t|+|a|+|b|)/3−1. This repairs the reference while preserving the −1/4 independent-gluing failure. The construction depends on actual AFFINITY: its trace sources need not dominate every interior supporting affine form of a nonlinear target. Different overlaps, extra nonincident pages and general nonlinear extensions remain excluded.

The finite foundations are supported by n1; n2 supplies only the separate compatible-affine-reference conclusion used in the scope comparison. The obstruction proof itself uses no approximation or MA theorem. Its complete coverage is in reconstructed-proofs.md and proof-coverage.md.

Use v₁=(0,1,0), v₂=(0,0,1), v₃=(0,−1,−1), with Σv_i=0, and pages span(e₀,v_i). Originals are σ_i={s≥0,0≤u=t+s≤1}, sharing τ=[0,1]e₀; their recession ray is (−1,1). For rational A≥1, f_A=max(0,s−Au) is continuous rational-affine PA on a rational wall. Its gradients give global block-l1 Lipschitz A. Actual γ=s has recession slope1, and f_A−γ=max(−s,−Au)∈[−A,0]; the target has eventual recession slope1 too. Its actual τ trace is0 and the common ambient zero form supports all originals. At τ every endpoint value is nonnegative; off τ assigned cells lie in the unique page and convexity proves Jensen. Thus the target is already partial printed-PC PA. Its outer facets have only one incident top cell, so the original partial support is unbalanced and regularizes by its constant PA sequence.

A convex carrier cell in a finite union of pages lies in one page: otherwise its relative interior would be covered by finitely many proper affine subspaces. The product of nonzero affine equations vanishing on those subspaces is a nonzero polynomial and cannot vanish on an open set, by successive one-variable restrictions.

Every finite-valued continuous printed-PC FULL-book competitor is convex on each ENTIRE page. Within each inherited cell, rational endpoint tests are legal because the center's minimal face is incident to that cell. Rational density follows from rational equality kernels while preserving inactive slack; continuity extends the inequalities to real points and weights. A rational page segment meets finitely many rational break parameters. Locally finite carriers also have finitely many cells on a compact segment. At each breakpoint q choose short rational left/right endpoints in the actual adjacent closed cells, both incident to its minimal face. The legal PCC orders left and right secants. Convexity within each side and fixed opposite-side secants bound and order the finite one-sided derivatives. Crossing secants are length-weighted averages. Induction gives convexity along the whole rational segment, and endpoint approximation gives whole-page convexity. No illegal coarsening or direct nonincident test is used.

For rational y_T=−Te₀ choose one sufficiently small rational δ∈(0,1) so w_i=y_T+δTv_i lie in actual cells incident to the minimal H face at y_T. Local ray intervals and closedness supply these assignments. Their mean is y_T, so this SMALL PCC is legal. Whole-page convexity gives F(w_i)≤(1−δ)F(y_T)+δF(z_i), z_i=y_T+Tv_i. Summation and cancellation derive F(y_T)≤average F(z_i). The far endpoints may be nonincident.

For exact agreement and A>1, T=1 gives F(−e₀)≤1. Choose rational 0<u*<min(1,1/(A−1)) and q=(−1,1+u*) in an original interior. There the target equals L=−At+(1−A)s on an open neighborhood. An affine open piece of a whole-page convex function is a global support, by initial affine secants. Hence F(−e₀)≥A>1, contradiction. At A=2 this is exactly 2≤F(−e₀)≤1.

For finite GLOBAL original error ε, EVERY integer T≥max(1,A−1) has original z_i=(−T,T) with target T, giving F(y_T)≤T+ε. The original r₁=(−T,T+1) has target T+1−A and z₁=(y_T+Tr₁)/(T+1). Ordinary whole-page convexity gives F(y_T)≥(T+1)F(z₁)−TF(r₁)≥AT−(2T+1)ε. Therefore ε≥(A−1)T/[2(T+1)]. If ε<(A−1)/2, choose an integer with (A−1)/(2(T+1)) smaller than the positive discrepancy, obtaining a contradiction. Infinite errors satisfy the bound trivially; A=1 gives0. This is an UNBOUNDED integer proof, not finite-grid extrapolation.

The FULL ambient convex rational-PA witness F_A=max(0,−t)−c, c=(A−1)/2, satisfies every printed PCC. On originals, monotonicity and the 1-Lipschitz positive-part map give 0≤max(0,s−u)−max(0,s−Au)≤(A−1)u≤A−1. Subtract c to get GLOBAL error≤c. At u=0 the error is −c; at u=1,s≥A it is +c. Thus the exact infimum is c and is attained, including A=1.

Competitors need no PA, growth, properness or reference condition. The witness is not claimed boundedly relative to an arbitrary proper full-book reference. Smaller competitor classes retain the lower bound but may lose attainment. This obstructs exact AND arbitrary-accuracy extension followed by restriction while remaining consistent with n2's affine-reference extension. It proves no original balanced regularization failure. Original P05.1/P05.2 and the direct-original balanced all-face approximation gap remain OPEN.
